```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof cfg = {
  const specs = dist.distributions;
  const names = Object.keys(specs);
  const state = ["Normal", "Exponential", "Beta"].map(n => ({dist: n, p: specs[n].params.map(q => q.value)}));
  const root = html`<div style="display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:0.5rem"></div>`;
  const snapshot = () => state.map(s => ({dist: s.dist, p: [...s.p]}));
  const emit = () => { root.value = snapshot(); root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); };
  state.forEach((s, i) => {
    const col = html`<div style="min-width:150px"><div style="font-weight:600">Distribución ${i + 1}</div></div>`;
    const sel = html`<select style="width:100%">${names.map(n => html`<option>${n}</option>`)}</select>`;
    sel.value = s.dist;
    const rows = [0, 1].map(k => {
      const lab = html`<label style="display:block; font-size:0.85em; margin-top:4px"><span></span></label>`;
      const inp = html`<input type="number" step="any" style="width:100%">`;
      inp.addEventListener("input", () => { const v = parseFloat(inp.value); if (Number.isFinite(v)) { s.p[k] = v; emit(); } });
      lab.append(inp);
      return {lab, inp};
    });
    const refresh = () => {
      const ps = specs[s.dist].params;
      rows.forEach((r, k) => {
        r.lab.style.display = k < ps.length ? "block" : "none";
        r.lab.firstChild.textContent = ps[k] ? ps[k].label + ": " : "";
        r.inp.value = s.p[k] ?? "";
      });
    };
    sel.addEventListener("input", () => { s.dist = sel.value; s.p = specs[s.dist].params.map(q => q.value); refresh(); emit(); });
    col.append(sel, ...rows.map(r => r.lab));
    root.append(col);
    refresh();
  });
  root.value = snapshot();
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const specs = dist.distributions;
  const colors = ["#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c"];
  const N = 200;
  const series = cfg.map((c, i) => {
    const D = specs[c.dist];
    if (!D.valid(...c.p)) return null;
    const [lo, hi] = D.range(...c.p);
    const label = `${c.dist}(${c.p.join(", ")})`;
    return d3.range(N + 1).map(k => {
      const x = lo + (hi - lo) * k / N, f = D.pdf(x, ...c.p);
      return {x, pdf: Number.isFinite(f) ? f : NaN, cdf: D.cdf(x, ...c.p), label, color: colors[i]};
    });
  }).filter(Boolean);
  const data = series.flat();
  const color = {domain: series.map(s => s[0].label), range: series.map(s => s[0].color)};
  const make = (y, legend) => Plot.plot({
    width: 640, height: 250, marginLeft: 55,
    x: {label: "x", grid: true}, y: {label: null, grid: true},
    color: {...color, legend},
    marks: [Plot.line(data, {x: "x", y, stroke: "label", strokeWidth: 2})]
  });
  return html`<div id="widgetDist" style="max-width:640px">
    <div style="font-weight:600">Función de densidad</div>${make("pdf", true)}
    <div style="font-weight:600; margin-top:0.5rem">Función de probabilidad acumulada</div>${make("cdf", false)}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(6, 5.5))
for d, lab, c in [(stats.norm(0, 1), "Normal(0, 1)", "C0"), (stats.expon(scale=1), "Exponential(1)", "C1"), (stats.beta(2, 5), "Beta(2, 5)", "C2")]:
    xx = np.linspace(d.ppf(0.0005), d.ppf(0.9995), 400)
    ax1.plot(xx, d.pdf(xx), color=c, label=lab)
    ax2.plot(xx, d.cdf(xx), color=c)
ax1.set(title="Función de densidad", xlabel="x"); ax1.legend()
ax2.set(title="Función de probabilidad acumulada", xlabel="x")
for ax in (ax1, ax2): ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
